{{Quote|I come from an ancient warrior tradition. That tradition will dismantle you.|Shyla Varad|<ref name="JR">{{SWIA|set=Jabba's Realm}}</ref>}}
'''Shyla Varad''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who hailed from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]],<ref name="ASAS" /> the cultural [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the Mandalorian people, located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Varad became renowned for her skill with both a pair of [[Sword/Legends|blades]] and a [[Fibercord whip/Legends|fibercord whip]],<ref name="JR2">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2016/8/5/jabbas-realm|text=Jabba's Realm: Announcing a New Expansion for Imperial Assault}}</ref> using both in tandem on the battlefield to great effect. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Varad found herself far from home and cut off from her people, but she continued to live by Mandalorian tradition and eventually took up arms against the Empire.<ref name="ASAS" /> Varad was obsessed with learning about the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] after she learned of a hidden base that contained records of the group.<ref name="Born from Death">{{SWIA|set=Jabba's Realm|mission=Born from Death}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Bladestorm_IA-JR.png|thumb|left|250px|Varad dispatches a trio of stormtroopers]]
{{Quote|I will hunt my enemies, and when I find them, I will defeat them.|Shyla Varad|<ref name="JR" />}}
Shyla Varad greatly admired the Mandalorian splinter group known as the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] and sought to learn all she could about the group, to the point of obsession.<ref name="Born from Death" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|There is no substitute for an extreme targeted strike.|Shyla Varad|<ref name="JR" />}}
[[File:RemoteDetonator-SWIA-JR.png|thumb|right|250px|Varad's remote detonators were mobile on tiny droid legs]]
Shyla Varad possessed a suit of traditional [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]], comprised of a set of [[chrome]]-[[Color/Legends|grey]] plates over a blue [[Flight suit/Legends|flight suit]], in addition to a brown [[Leather/Legends|leather]] [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]] worn at her waist, and a light blue cape. Her [[Armor/Legends|armor]] was equipped with a [[Whipcord launcher/Legends|whipcord launcher]], and Varad owned a pair of [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibroswords]], along with a variety of [[Smoke grenade/Legends|smoke bombs]] and [[remote detonator]]s.<ref name="ASAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The character of Shyla Varad was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the "[[Jabba's Realm]]" expansion pack for the ''[[Star Wars: Imperial Assault]]'' strategy [[Board game/Legends|board game]]. Her appearance in in-game art depicts Varad in Mandalorian armor similar in appearance to the armor worn by [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] during his later life, seen most notably in the second entry of the ''Star Wars'' [[prequel trilogy]], [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]. Varad also shares her surname with the Mandalorians of [[Clan Varad]], introduced in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
